reason: Successfully tested agent message flow: navigated to app, opened agent QA-20261013-001501-d420 with idle status, sent arithmetic question, received correct response mentioning "4".
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — Page loaded successfully showing Gamut app with sidebar containing agents list.
Found and clicked agent "QA-20261013-001501-d420" in sidebar — Agent page opened, URL changed to /agents/qa-20261013-001501-d420-rwxitq9xav.
Verified agent status is "running" or "idle" — Agent status displayed as "idle" in the UI (visible in top-right corner of agent page).
Sent message "Hello! What is 2+2?" — Message successfully typed into input field and sent via Send button, creating new session "Basic Arithmetic Greeting Question".
Waited up to 3 minutes for response — Agent finished processing within timeout period, activity indicator disappeared after receiving response.

Verified response mentions "4" and took screenshot — Agent responded with "2 + 2 = 4." clearly showing the number 4 in the response. Screenshot saved as 02_agent_response_verified.png showing both user message "Hello! What is 2+2?" and agent response "2 + 2 = 4."
